goals: Contribute the exact audited literal block and accessory families to Clutter No More ShapeMap so approved material forms can share one interchangeable storage family.
Preserve Clutter No More as the sole switching, transmutation, recipe-cleanup, and equivalence authority while keeping component patches and source variants exact.

Preserve exact accepted C7 byte-for-byte as the accepted baseline while C13 excludes the literal BGE-owned patterned geometry cells from C12's provider-first masonry matrix; C13 remains runtime-untested.
scope: Preserve every accepted C7 family, every C8/C9/C10 addition, and every canonical parent while excluding C13's exact literal BGE-owned patterned full/slab/stair geometry: the 17 audited masonry profiles retain 442 eligible cells (253 provider, 189 AMC), yielding 166 families, 1,607 unique item IDs, and a 26-member maximum without suffix, tag, or namespace inference.

Use the actual Minecraft 26.2 and Enderscape 3.0.2 registries as the display-fixture authority: the complete eligible set is the 12 literal vanilla wood families plus Enderscape Veiled, Celestial, and Murublight; Sign is canonical, Hanging Sign and Shelf are alternates, and wall placement blocks are excluded because they are not inventory items.

Preserve pre/post ShapeMap collision validation, equal-component-patch equivalence, fail-closed transfer validation, audited alternate-door loot narrowing, recipe cleanup contracts, Quick Stack Nearby affinity, and large-family viewport handling.
Retain exact accepted C7 and historical rollback C3 artifacts while C12 is the current candidate; no owner acceptance or manual Minecraft runtime result is inferred from static evidence.

exclusions: Clutter No More owns ShapeMap, selection controls, 1:1 transmuteCopy switching, recipe equivalence and cleanup, and the graph consumed by Quick Stack Nearby; IBF does not add a second registry, switcher, keybind, networking protocol, recipe engine, or storage-equivalence system.

Minecraft, Enderscape, Macaw, and Dramatic Doors providers own native blocks, placement, collision, redstone, recipes and costs, drops, copper weathering, waxing, scraping, and lightning behavior; IBF does not normalize or replace those semantics.

Nibaru and Block Geometry Extensions own ordinary slabs, stairs, walls, and generated geometry and material behavior, while Quick Stack Nearby and its compatibility layer only consume Clutter No More affinity; IBF does not modify, duplicate, or bundle those projects.

Partial provider materialization, dynamic discovery, registry-name or tag inference, and cross-material or cross-finish collapsing remain outside the audited contract. C12's approved provider-first masonry cells include only their explicitly enumerated Macaw paving, full, slab, and stair forms.
C12 is an unaccepted candidate and does not alter the exact accepted C7 release identity, any Minecraft testing profile, or the separate human-owned server-release record.
Legacy status READMEs, provenance and audit narratives, historical C1/C2 matrices and binaries, manager records, snapshots, branches, worktrees, and Git history are not imported.
